newsitem.title: USA: U.S. equity funds steady in past 3 days - survey.
newsitem.headline: U.S. equity funds steady in past 3 days - survey.

text.p: An estimated $2.5 billion flowed into U.S. equity funds for the three days ending July 31, for a monthly pace of $18.3 billion, Mutual Fund Trim Tabs reported.
Flows into all equity funds, including international funds, jumped to $3.9 billion compared with $174 million for the period ended July 28, the tracking firm said.
Aggressive growth funds took in $278 million compared with outflows of $184 million, the firm said.
Growth funds saw inflows of $870 million for the three days, compared with inflows of $475 million, while growth and income funds took in $1.35 billion, up from $548 million.
International funds received $1.4 billion over the three days versus outflows of $672 million in the prior period.
Bond and income funds took in $159 million, down from $377 million. Flows into high-yield funds fell to $10 million from $117 million in the previous period.
